name: Armenia
summary: Armenia taxes residents on worldwide income at a flat 20%, but income from the sale of shares and other investment securities is exempt for individuals, and dividends are taxed at 5%. Inheritances and gifts received from individuals are exempt from income tax, and there is no wealth tax (only annual property tax on real estate and vehicles). Corporate tax 18%. Medium-to-low confidence: the securities exemption comes from a 2023 KPMG summary and was not checked against the current Tax Code.

regimes.name: Armenia tax residence
regimes.description: Gains on securities exempt; dividends 5%; no inheritance or wealth tax.
regimes.eligibility: Tax resident: 183+ days in the calendar year, or centre of vital interests in Armenia.

capital_gains.summary: Armenia has no separate capital gains tax. Income from the sale of stocks and other investment securities is exempt income for individuals (KPMG). Income from the sale of property paid by a tax agent is taxed at 10%; sales of non-business property to other individuals are exempt (PwC).

sources.title: Armenia - Individual - Taxes on personal income (last reviewed 30 Jun 2026)
Armenia Tax Cheat Sheet for Investors (Sept 2025)

open_questions: The securities exemption (Tax Code art. 147) was taken from KPMG's 2023 summary; confirm that it still covers foreign listed securities in 2026.
Whether the 10% on property sold to a tax agent is levied on gross proceeds or on the gain was not verified.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Securities and private company shares scored 0 (exempt income). Local real estate scored at 10%: the rate when the buyer is a tax agent (company or entrepreneur); a sale to another individual is exempt. Foreign real estate sold to a foreign individual assumed exempt.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Individual entrepreneurs are taxed on business income; frequent trading by a private investor is not known to be recharacterised.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents are taxed on worldwide income with a foreign tax credit, but the securities exemption is not limited to Armenian securities (per KPMG).

dividends.summary: Dividends are taxed at 5% (for profits from 2020 onward), withheld by Armenian payers. Dividends on shares listed in Armenia by 31.12.2024 are exempt. Foreign tax is credited up to the Armenian tax.

sources.title: Armenia - Individual - Taxes on personal income (last reviewed 30 Jun 2026)
Armenia - Individual - Foreign tax relief and tax treaties

open_questions: PwC and KPMG state the 5% dividend rate without distinguishing foreign-source dividends; confirm that foreign dividends are not taxed at the general 20% rate.
dividends.rate_basis: 5% statutory dividend rate; assumed to apply to foreign dividends received by residents (self-declared).
dividends.withholding_outbound: 5% WHT on dividends to non-residents; treaty rates; no WHT on gains from securities.
dividends.treaty_network: About 47 treaties (PwC list: most EU states, Switzerland, UK, UAE, Qatar, Hong Kong, Cyprus, Luxembourg). No modern US treaty listed.

sources.title: Armenia - Individual - Other taxes (last reviewed 30 Jun 2026)

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Annual property tax on real estate (cadastral value) and vehicles is levied by communities; rates not verified. Not a wealth tax.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance or gift tax. Property and money received by inheritance or as a gift from individuals are exempt income (KPMG).

sources.title: Armenia - Individual - Other taxes (last reviewed 30 Jun 2026)

inheritance.gift_tax: Gifts from individuals are exempt; gifts from tax agents (companies) are taxed as other income at 20%.

residency.tax_residency_test: Resident if physically present 183 days or more in the calendar year, or centre of vital interests in Armenia, or in the Armenian civil service (PwC).

routes.name: Temporary / permanent residence permit
routes.requirements: Many nationalities can stay visa-free up to 180 days a year; long-term stay needs a temporary (1-year) or permanent residence permit on grounds such as business, employment or Armenian descent. No golden visa programme. Details not verified.

corporate.summary: CIT 18%; investment funds 0.01% of net assets; turnover tax and micro-enterprise regimes for SMEs.

sources.title: Armenia - Corporate - Taxes on corporate income

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain US-taxed. The 1973 US-USSR treaty has been reported to apply to Armenia; not verified.
